text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, the two of us were casually
strolling around the academy grounds, and...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk, tsk!
Come on now! Don't be scared!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There, good girl.
Pardon me for a moment, gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gyah!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Ow, dammit! That really hits the spot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are you doing a solo comedy sketch?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Tama and the gang! Perfect timing.
Take a peek down this gutter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking closely at the spot I was directed to—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's a fox!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's right, the little fox pup
got all tangled up in the net.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
He's all riled up right now.
Even if I try to drag him out, he'll just bite me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What the, it's all gooey and gross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel bad just leavin' it alone, though...
What should we do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's calm down for a second.
Let's climb down into the gutter and use some guts to grab the net!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right. Let me whip ya up somethin' to eat.
I actually just got back from the supermarket anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Somethin' the fox might eat, somethin' it might eat~..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Here, have some delicious beans~.

text_block_list.name: Fox
text_block_list.text: Kyuu...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're watching, they're watching!
Go on, go on~, have some~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fox stretched its neck,
and the exact moment it grabbed the bean in its mouth—!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The fox disappeared!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec.
Right where that fox girl was, there's something—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A slightly nicer stopwatch!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're returning the favor?
Ahaha! Well, aren't you sweet!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, strange things really do happen.
...Mind if I use this, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, huh.
Guts is my middle name, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Come on, just give up already.
Ol' Tama-chan here'll help ya out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Tamamo Cross jumped into the ditch
and ripped away the grate—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The entire area was enveloped in a dazzling light—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? It's already evening!? How!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Tama, over there...
There's a crazy gorgeous girl standing there."
Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh—?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-It's back!
What was that just now!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What in the world is that drink?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seriously!?
What on earth is this drink!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's delicious.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You're actually gonna drink it?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She did say 'thank you,' so
maybe it's the fox spirit repaying its debt?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Strange things really do happen, huh...
